Container.Name: MotoGParr
Container.Overview:
MotoGParr watches the race calendar, searches Prowlarr, sends releases to SABnzbd, then sorts the finished download into a Plex-friendly MotoGP / Moto2 / Moto3 folder structure, applies artwork and tags, and exposes a small WebUI.
Open the WebUI on port 5679 to configure Prowlarr, SABnzbd, Plex and paths. Settings are stored in /config/settings.yml, which persists across updates.
Updating: this image is rebuilt by GitHub Actions on every release. Use Docker -> Force Update to move to the latest release (the :latest tag only moves on a release, never on an in-progress commit).
Calendars: season calendars are shipped inside the image and compared against the copy in /config at startup, so a rescheduled race (for example a postponed Qatar round) is reported or refreshed automatically. Set MOTOGPARR_CALENDAR_UPDATE=warn if you edit calendars by hand.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the MotoGParr WebUI.

Config.Name: Config folder
Config.Description: Holds settings.yml, your season calendars and the grabber state. Keep this across updates.

Config.Name: MotoGP library
Config.Description: Your media share, mounted so the container can read and write the MotoGP library. This is the path Plex also sees.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Your downloads share, mounted so completed downloads can be picked up and moved. Must match the completed-download folder you give SABnzbd.

Config.Name: Library path (optional)
Config.Description: LEAVE BLANK unless you want to override settings.yml. Where the MotoGP library lives INSIDE the container, e.g. /media/Motorsport/MotoGP. Set here it beats settings.yml, which is a common surprise - blank means 'use settings.yml'.

Config.Name: Downloads path (optional)
Config.Description: LEAVE BLANK unless you want to override settings.yml. Where completed downloads appear INSIDE the container, e.g. /downloads/complete/motogp.

Config.Name: Plex path prefix - container side (optional)
Config.Description: Plex reports paths as its own container sees them. Set this to the path prefix as MotoGParr sees it (often /media) and the matching Plex side below, or matching by exact path will silently never work. Blank means 'use settings.yml'.

Config.Name: Plex path prefix - Plex side (optional)
Config.Description: The same prefix as Plex sees it, e.g. /data/media. Must be paired with the container-side value above.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used for scheduling and log timestamps. Use a TZ database name, e.g. Europe/London.

Config.Name: Skip path check (rarely needed)
Config.Description: Leave blank. Set to 1 only to start despite a missing library path - for example while reorganising a share. A missing library path normally stops the container so it cannot run for hours doing nothing.

Config.Name: Calendar updates
Config.Description: What to do when the calendar in /config differs from the one in the image. auto = refresh it and keep a .bak (only when it is provably the same season). warn = report it and never write. off = stay quiet. Use warn if you edit calendars by hand.

Config.Name: Prowlarr URL (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. If left blank, set it in the WebUI instead. Values here override settings.yml. e.g. http://192.168.1.100:9696

Config.Name: Prowlarr API key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. If left blank, set it in the WebUI instead.

Config.Name: SABnzbd URL (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. If left blank, set it in the WebUI instead. e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8080

Config.Name: SABnzbd API key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. If left blank, set it in the WebUI instead.

Config.Name: Plex URL (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. If left blank, set it in the WebUI instead. e.g. http://192.168.1.100:32400

Config.Name: Plex token (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. If left blank, set it in the WebUI instead. See https://support.plex.tv/articles/204059436

Config.Name: Plex library section ID (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. The number in the Plex URL when you open the MotoGP library: /library/sections/<ID>/

Config.Name: Plex library name (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Display name of the Plex library, used for logging only.

Config.Name: Auth: Cloudflare issuer
Config.Description: Only needed if this container is reachable from the internet through Cloudflare Access. Your team's issuer URL, e.g. https://yourteam.cloudflareaccess.com - found in Cloudflare Zero Trust under Access > Applications. Leave blank to keep the WebUI unauthenticated (LAN use only).

Config.Name: Auth: Access audience (AUD) tag
Config.Description: The Access application's AUD tag. Tokens issued for any other application are rejected. Required if AUTH_ISSUER is set.

Config.Name: Auth: allowed emails
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of email addresses allowed in. Cloudflare's email policy is the outer gate; this is the app's own copy of it. A verified address that is not listed here is denied - there is no sign-up.

Config.Name: Auth: mode
Config.Description: Leave blank to decide automatically: cloudflare when AUTH_ISSUER is set, otherwise none. Set cloudflare to require the token even if the issuer is misconfigured (fails closed). Set none only for local development - it logs a warning and shows a banner in the UI.

Config.Name: Auth: certs URL override
Config.Description: Leave blank. Overrides where the Access signing keys are fetched from; defaults to AUTH_ISSUER/cdn-cgi/access/certs.

Config.Name: Discord webhook (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Post a message to Discord when a session is grabbed or fails.
